selection_basis.rule: From the C1 J3 population, choose the first company by ascending company_id.

eligibility_rule: A result-unseen curator may emit a cutoff-before field only when every material input read by that curator is cutoff-before or an allowed value-free technical identity. Exposure to post-cutoff company material terminates this curator's eligibility before source extraction.

finding.material_reason: The requested existing-record eligibility check exposed post-cutoff company material. The curator stopped before opening any CN:000651 annual-report PDF or technical route endpoint, so it cannot truthfully represent a newly emitted record as result-unseen.
finding.economic_impact: No CN:000651 metric may enter a forecast, contract, outcome-access request, settlement, learning record, CJO, valuation, report, or investment decision from this curator run.
finding.missing_fact: A fresh independent curator must establish the one cutoff-before, directly disclosed listed-consolidated field without accessing post-cutoff company material.
prohibited_assumptions: A later company-judgment PRE_FREEZE record can determine eligibility for the distinct 2017 C1 Minimal lane.
A directly disclosed FY2016 field would cure this curator's exposure after post-cutoff material was read.
The absence of a submitted baseline means CN:000651 has no stable public field.
finding.executable_remediation: Assign a fresh curator whose read set is limited to the C1 J234/source-register identities, the selected cutoff-before official static PDF, and the value-free code-to-organization resolver. The curator must create a new immutable submission before any forecast or outcome access.
finding.acceptance_criteria: The replacement submission records one official static PDF identity, pre-cutoff publication date, physical page, exact quote, listed-consolidated metric/unit, and value-free route identity; its declared input boundary excludes all post-cutoff materials.

not_a_company_conclusion: This stop does not conclude that CN:000651 lacks a stable issuer-consolidated metric.
This stop does not evaluate CN:000651's operating quality, customer position, cash, owner cash, permanent-loss risk, price, or return.
